brief:
Rafah's supply police, in coordination with the Economy Ministry, confiscated 327 kilograms of foodstuffs displaying clear signs of spoilage during regulatory inspections across the city's markets and commercial shops, Shehab Wire reported. Officers discovered the contaminated goods while conducting systematic sweeps aimed at enforcing food safety standards.

The operation represents part of broader enforcement efforts to protect consumers from unsafe products. Authorities did not specify which establishments were targeted or detail the types of food seized during the inspections.
